text:
$HBAR swung hard, its 24-hour range hit about 31% while it usually sits near 11%, that's more than twice the normal swing.

$LINK wasn't far behind; it covered roughly 15.5% in the day versus a typical 7.7%, also more than double its usual spread.

$ZEC moved a bit less extreme but still broke the norm, trading a 16.8% range compared with its average 9.8%, noticeably wider than usual.

All three showed a lot more volatility than they normally do. Nothing else crazy on the board.
